readerCopy.body: One honest preference can undo more shame than another year of trying not to want it. When Chiron sextiles Lilith, a small act of refusal or self-definition can give you a different ending to something you once learned was embarrassing, selfish, excessive, or unacceptable. Ask for the different term. Decline what does not fit. Admit the preference without adding a defense brief. The consequence may be much smaller than the one you have been avoiding for years. You are not proving the old judgment wrong in theory; you are finding out how much authority it still has in practice.
